name: preview-card-1b
title: Preview Card 1b: Flush preview
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. No inset. The preview runs edge to edge, with a divider above the footer.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
